race.description: Brad Widdup 25-26 Hrc Champion Local Trainer Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: Tough race to end the day. SOCIABLE (2) found the line nicely with the 59.5kg when a solid second to Cuban Cigar over 1300m at Wyong. That form has held up and expected to go one better. AUSBRED HED'N'TAIL (7) improving entire who drifted back from his wide draw on resumption before launching late to run second over 1200m at Newcastle. Key jockey change and looking for this trip and further now. Each way. DASHING RUPERT (1) drops in grade and gets the services of Grima's 1.5kg claim from the sticky gate today. Closed well to run fifth over 1300m at Randwick Kensington in BM72 grade. At his peak for this and can hold a position from the draw. Respect. GUS THE GREAT (3) demolished a Maiden field with plenty up the sleeve over 1200m at Gosford with the 59kg. Chad Schofield sticks and can make further progress this time in. Each way from the barrier.
